title: office.scribe-control request
description: Read or change one session's scribe control record in Office plugin state. get, request_now and heartbeat take only op and session_id; set_switch takes on; set_title takes title; consume_now takes an optional requested_at (clears the pending Capture-now request only if it is still that request).

on.description: set_switch only: the new switch state.

title.description: set_title only: a single-line user title.

requested_at.description: consume_now only: the now_requested_at value read earlier; omit to clear any pending request.
